name: Tutsak
languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Danish, Dutch, Polish, Norwegian, Portuguese - Portugal, Swedish, Italian
short: Explore abandoned locations with 1–4 players. The creature hunts, captures, and imprisons you — your teammates must find you before it's too late. Can you escape together?
about: TUTSAK - Co-op Survival Horror       Enter abandoned and dangerous locations with your friends.       Your goal: Collect the keys and escape alive.     🔑 GAMEPLAY                 Up to 4-player online co-op        Survive in various abandoned locations       Collect keys to unlock your escape route      On some maps, you'll also need to find a code to escape     Hide from and evade the creature        ⚠️ CAPTURE MECHANIC                The creature can capture you and throw you in prison or spare you!          You're trapped and helpless     Your teammates must find the prison key      You have limited escape attempts     Teamwork is essential for survival        🎮 FEATURES              Realistic 3D graphics      Tense atmosphere    Map-based code puzzle mechanic      Terrifying sound design      Multiple maps     Team-based survival      Do you have the courage to rescue your friends?       📷 This game includes an optional camera-based blink detection feature.       It is disabled by default and can be enabled in settings.       No images or video are recorded or transmitted.
min_req: Minimum:    Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system    OS:  Windows (64-bit) 10    Processor:  Intel Core i5-7600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600    Memory:  8 GB RAM    Graphics:  NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570    DirectX:  Version 11    Storage:  22 GB available space
